import json, subprocess, sys
PY=sys.executable; SUB="/app/submission/main.py"
def comp(cfg):
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()[:60]
base={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10,"packet_limit":5,"prefix_width":2,
      "fallback":{"class":8}}
def rule(i,nr=1):
    return {"id":i,"class":1,"priority":0,"ranges":[[0,1]]*nr}
# 2048 rules ok
cfg=dict(base); cfg["rules"]=[rule(i) for i in range(2048)]
print("2048 rules:", comp(cfg)[0])
# 2049 rules -> invalid
cfg["rules"]=[rule(i) for i in range(2049)]
print("2049 rules:", comp(cfg)[0])
# 512 rules x 32 ranges = 16384 positions -> valid
cfg["rules"]=[rule(i,32) for i in range(512)]
print("16384 positions:", comp(cfg)[0])
# 513 x 32 = 16416 -> invalid
cfg["rules"]=[rule(i,32) for i in range(513)]
print("16416 positions:", comp(cfg)[0])
# 33 ranges -> invalid
cfg["rules"]=[rule(0,33)]
print("33 ranges:", comp(cfg)[0])
# 32 ranges ok
cfg["rules"]=[rule(0,32)]
print("32 ranges:", comp(cfg)[0])
